amendment_reason: The v1 runner incorrectly validated archived CB_MISSING fit_rows against the missing-stream subset. Archived controls were trained on all rows through each cutoff and routed only on missing-stream validation rows.
amendment_changes_only: Validate archived CB_MISSING training fingerprint against all official Train rows with 47 <= cycle_code <= cutoff.
Validate C2_B and CB_MISSING controls at both cutoffs 55 and 67 completely before the first new native-text fit.
Use a new v2 freeze and cache namespace; preserve all v1 source, freeze, and failure evidence.

unchanged_candidate_protocol.fit_rows: All official Classification Train rows with 47 <= cycle_code <= cutoff, including rows whose signal_stream is missing or blank.

evaluation_views.fit55: cycles 56-67 for H12_E, with cycles 56-59 reported as W1
evaluation_views.fit67: cycles 68-79 for H12_L, with cycles 68-71 reported as W4

unchanged_candidate_protocol.candidate: CatBoostClassifier with frozen expanded structured/native categorical parser plus raw signal_stream native text; replaces only present-stream C2_B at prediction time.
unchanged_candidate_protocol.control_fit_scope: Both archived C2_B and CB_MISSING components were fitted on all official Train rows through each cutoff. Stream availability selects the validation-time branch only.
unchanged_candidate_protocol.routing: Compute original stream availability mask before text sentinel normalization. Missing/blank validation rows retain exact archived CB_MISSING scores. Present validation rows use the native-text candidate. The current champion remains C2_B present plus CB_MISSING missing.

native_text.tokenizer: Space tokenizer; split on a single space with ByDelimiter; lowercasing false
native_text.dictionary: Unigram; gram_order 1; CatBoost Python API spelling occurence_lower_bound=3; max_dictionary_size=20000
native_text.fit_only: Text dictionary/calcer state is learned internally from all rows supplied to model.fit; no eval_set or external text corpus.

pilot_gate.improvement: At least one pooled view (W1+W4 Primary or H12_E+H12_L) must improve current-champion Macro F1.
pilot_gate.guardrail: No individual W1, W4, H12_E, or H12_L Macro F1 may be more than 0.01 below current champion.
pilot_gate.stop: Report pilot and stop for Main review; full-six continuation requires explicit Main decision.
